name: Bastard Pennyroyal
desc: Bastard Pennyroyal (Trichostema dichotomum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trichostema dichotomum, commonly known as forked bluecurls, is a flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). The plant is found in the Midwestern and Eastern United States, and Eastern Canada.
